step.action: Observe whether water flows into the basin and drains without leaking.
step.ifThen: IF water does not flow or drain normally, or a leak is present, THEN close the tap, display 🔧 Out_of_Service_Sign, stop the task, and tell the Dominatrix.

step.action: Remove debris from the basin and drain with 🍳 Disposable_Towels.
Wipe the sprayed residue with 🍳 Disposable_Towels.

passWhen.criterion: Potable water flows and drains into the gray-water system.
The basin and drain are clear of debris and visible residue.
No water is leaking or pooled around the sink.
